args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A few notes on the PHL label confusion for Pellow Home Living:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. Older exports and reports still use the old name.
- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast). Filtering on "PHL" returns both accounts, so check the account name before acting on a PHL row.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It should be relabelled to Pellow Home Living.
- The Pemberline Dock export and the carrier appointment emails may still show the old Covey & Lark heading; support was asked to look at the export label.

From Sofia Marchetti, via assistant.

args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A few notes on the PHL label cleanup for Pellow Home Living:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. Older exports and reports still use the old name.
- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so a PHL filter returns both accounts. The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It needs relabelling to Pellow Home Living.
- The Pemberline Dock export and carrier appointment emails may still show the old Covey & Lark heading. Sofia planned to raise this with support; that is not yet confirmed.

From Sofia Marchetti, via Bettina Kroll.
